addedLines: - academic-research-skills:report_compiler_agent: Transforms research findings into polished APA 7.0 academic reports; activated in Phase 4 and Phase 6 (Tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob)

- academic-research-skills:research_architect_agent: Designs the methodological blueprint; selects research paradigm, method, data strategy, and analytical framework (Tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob)
- academic-research-skills:synthesis_agent: Integrates findings across sources, resolves evidence conflicts, and maps knowledge gaps (Tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob)
- claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - API usage, tool use, Anthropic SDK usage. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Bash, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

Coordinates deep-research, academic-paper, and academic-paper-reviewer into a seamless 10-stage workflow with mandatory, coverage-bounded integrity checks, two-stage peer review, and auditable quality-assurance artifacts. Triggers on: academic pipeline, research to paper, full paper workflow, paper pipeline, end-to-end paper, research-to-publication, complete paper workflow, 연구부터 논문까지, 연구 주제 설정부터 논문 완성까지, 논문 전체 워크플로.
- academic-research-skills:deep-research: Universal deep research agent team. 13-agent pipeline for rigorous academic research on any topic. 8 modes: full research, quick brief, paper review, lit-review, fact-check, three-way literature scan, Socratic guided research dialogue, and systematic review with optional meta-analysis. Covers research question formulation, Socratic mentoring, methodology design, systematic literature search, source verification, cross-source synthesis, risk of bias assessment, meta-analysis, APA 7.0 report compilation, editorial review, devil's advocate challenges, ethics review, and post-research literature monitoring. Triggers on: research, deep research, literature review, systematic review, meta-analysis, PRISMA, evidence synthesis, fact-check, WHY HOW WHAT papers, 3W literature scan, guide my research, help me think through, 研究, 深度研究, 文獻回顧, 文獻探討, 系統性回顧, 後設分析, 事實查核, 三段式文獻掃描, 引導我的研究, 幫我釐清, 幫我想想, 我不確定要研究什麼, 研究方向, 研究主題, 심층 연구, 문헌 조사, 체계적 문헌고찰, 메타분석, 사실 확인, 연구 방향을 잡아줘, 연구 주제 정하는 것을 도와줘.
- humanizer:humanizer: Rewrite AI-sounding text so it reads like the writer without changing what it says.
Use when editing or reviewing prose for AI tells: not-X-but-Y contrasts, one-line
closers, staged openers, forced triads, dashes everywhere, inflated claims, sales
language, stock AI words, bold labels, or filler. Based on Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing."
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by running the app and observing behavior. Use when asked to verify a PR, confirm a fix works, test a change manually, check that a feature works, or validate local changes before pushing.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation

现在我理解了 PR #234 的全部检视意见。让我梳理一下：

## PR #234 概况
- 标题：Maximize SDC excitation for ARM64 SDCShield
- 分支：`jules-6179826238522825613-c1296a5b` → `main`
- 作者：wangxumarshall（由 Jules 自动创建）
- 内容：
  - 移除了 ARM64 和 SVE 高价值计算测试中的 `.fracture_loop_count = -1`，以启用默认 fracture 行为
  - 修复了 x86 构建问题（mrs、yield 等 ARM64 指令进入 virtualization 测试的 x86 分支）
  - README 增加了 `SDC_EXTRA_ARGS="--max-test-loop-count=0"` 的替代命令

## 检视意见汇总

### 意见 1（CodeRabbit, 🟠 Major, 已解决）— vmx_io_exit.cpp 架构守卫
- `#ifdef __aarch64__` 被改成了 `#ifndef __aarch64__`，会导致 AArch64 构建选择 x86 分支（包含 cpuid 和 port-I/O 指令）而编译失败
- 状态：✅ Addressed in commit 54e57dc（已解决）

### 意见 2（CodeRabbit, 🟠 Major, outside diff）— fpcr_rounding_cartesian_arm.cpp 初始化器
- `fpcr_rounding_cartesian_arm_init` 被排除在 `__aarch64__` 之外，但 `DECLARE_TEST` 仍然引用它，会导致 AArch64 编译失败
- 这个似乎也已解决（后来的 review 没有再提）

### 意见 3（CodeRabbit, 🟡 Minor, 未解决）— README 的 SDC_EXTRA_ARGS 命令无效
- `excite.sh` 不转发 `SDC_EXTRA_ARGS` 到 systemd service，campaign runner 也不读取它
- 因此 `SDC_EXTRA_ARGS="--max-test-loop-count=0" sudo bash scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/excite.sh` 命令**不会**把 `--max-test-loop-count=0` 传递给 sdcshield
- 而且即使转发了，`--max-test-loop-count=0` 会**禁用** test fracturing，而不是启用自动 fracturing！

# Code Review Reception

## Overview

Code review requires technical evaluation, not emotional performance.

**Core principle:** Verify before implementing. Ask before assuming. Technical correctness over social comfort.

## The Response Pattern

```
WHEN receiving code review feedback:

1. READ: Complete feedback without reacting
2. UNDERSTAND: Restate requirement in own words (or ask)
3. VERIFY: Check against codebase reality
4. EVALUATE: Technically sound for THIS codebase?
5. RESPOND: Technical acknowledgment or reasoned pushback
6. IMPLEMENT: One item at a time, test each
```

## Forbidden Responses

**NEVER:**
- "You're absolutely right!" (explicit instruction-file violation)
- "Great point!" / "Excellent feedback!" (performative)
- "Let me implement that now" (before verification)

**INSTEAD:**
- Restate the technical requirement
- Ask clarifying questions
- Push back with technical reasoning if wrong
- Just start working (actions > words)

## Handling Unclear Feedback

```
IF any item is unclear:
  STOP - do not implement anything yet
  ASK for clarification on unclear items

WHY: Items may be related. Partial understanding = wrong implementation.
```

**Example:**
```
your human partner: "Fix 1-6"
You understand 1,2,3,6. Unclear on 4,5.

❌ WRONG: Implement 1,2,3,6 now, ask about 4,5 later
✅ RIGHT: "I understand items 1,2,3,6. Need clarification on 4 and 5 before proceeding."
```

## Source-Specific Handling

### From your human partner
- **Trusted** - implement after understanding
- **Still ask** if scope unclear
- **No performative agreement**
- **Skip to action** or technical acknowledgment

### From External Reviewers
```
BEFORE implementing:
  1. Check: Technically correct for THIS codebase?
  2. Check: Breaks existing functionality?
  3. Check: Reason for current implementation?
  4. Check: Works on all platforms/versions?
  5. Check: Does reviewer understand full context?

IF suggestion seems wrong:
  Push back with technical reasoning

IF can't easily verify:
  Say so: "I can't verify this without [X]. Should I [investigate/ask/proceed]?"

IF conflicts with your human partner's prior decisions:
  Stop and discuss with your human partner first
```

**your human partner's rule:** "External feedback - be skeptical, but check carefully"

## YAGNI Check for "Professional" Features

```
IF reviewer suggests "implementing properly":
  grep codebase for actual usage

  IF unused: "This endpoint isn't called. Remove it (YAGNI)?"
  IF used: Then implement properly
```

**your human partner's rule:** "You and reviewer both report to me. If we don't need this feature, don't add it."

## Implementation Order

```
FOR multi-item feedback:
  1. Clarify anything unclear FIRST
  2. Then implement in this order:
     - Blocking issues (breaks, security)
     - Simple fixes (typos, imports)
     - Complex fixes (refactoring, logic)
  3. Test each fix individually
  4. Verify no regressions
```

## When To Push Back

Push back when:
- Suggestion breaks existing functionality
- Reviewer lacks full context
- Violates YAGNI (unused feature)
- Technically incorrect for this stack
- Legacy/compatibility reasons exist
- Conflicts with your human partner's architectural decisions

**How to push back:**
- Use technical reasoning, not defensiveness
- Ask specific questions
- Reference working tests/code
- Involve your human partner if architectural

**If you're uncomfortable pushing back out loud:** Name that tension, then tell your partner about the issue you've seen. They'll appreciate your honesty.

## Acknowledging Correct Feedback

When feedback IS correct:
```
✅ "Fixed. [Brief description of what changed]"
✅ "Good catch - [specific issue]. Fixed in [location]."
✅ [Just fix it and show in the code]

❌ "You're absolutely right!"
❌ "Great point!"
❌ "Thanks for catching that!"
❌ "Thanks for [anything]"
❌ ANY gratitude expression
```

**Why no thanks:** Actions speak. Just fix it. The code itself shows you heard the feedback.

**If you catch yourself about to write "Thanks":** DELETE IT. State the fix instead.

## Gracefully Correcting Your Pushback

If you pushed back and were wrong:
```
✅ "You were right - I checked [X] and it does [Y]. Implementing now."
✅ "Verified this and you're correct. My initial understanding was wrong because [reason]. Fixing."

❌ Long apology
❌ Defending why you pushed back
❌ Over-explaining
```

State the correction factually and move on.

## Common Mistakes

| Mistake | Fix |
|---------|-----|
| Performative agreement | State requirement or just act |
| Blind implementation | Verify against codebase first |
| Batch without testing | One at a time, test each |
| Assuming reviewer is right | Check if breaks things |
| Avoiding pushback | Technical correctness > comfort |
| Partial implementation | Clarify all items first |
| Can't verify, proceed anyway | State limitation, ask for direction |

## Real Examples

**Performative Agreement (Bad):**
```
Reviewer: "Remove legacy code"
❌ "You're absolutely right! Let me remove that..."
```

**Technical Verification (Good):**
```
Reviewer: "Remove legacy code"
✅ "Checking... build target is 10.15+, this API needs 13+. Need legacy for backward compat. Current impl has wrong bundle ID - fix it or drop pre-13 support?"
```

**YAGNI (Good):**
```
Reviewer: "Implement proper metrics tracking with database, date filters, CSV export"
✅ "Grepped codebase - nothing calls this endpoint. Remove it (YAGNI)? Or is there usage I'm missing?"
```

**Unclear Item (Good):**
```
your human partner: "Fix items 1-6"
You understand 1,2,3,6. Unclear on 4,5.
✅ "Understand 1,2,3,6. Need clarification on 4 and 5 before implementing."
```

## GitHub Thread Replies

When replying to inline review comments on GitHub, reply in the comment thread (`gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pr}/comments/{id}/replies`), not as a top-level PR comment.

content.thinking:
现在看到 PR 的完整 diff。有意思的是：
- 最终 diff 只有 14 个文件：13 个测试文件删 `.fracture_loop_count = -1`，README 加一行。
- virtualization 测试文件的 x86 修复（意见 A、B）在后续 commit 中已经处理了（54e57dce 之前有 4254f8cb、db518367、6d089a2c、6f433e02 等 commit），并且最终 diff 里这些文件与 main 一致了——即中间 commit 修了又改回/或 main 已经包含？等等，最终 diff（three-dot，相对 merge-base）里没有 virtualization 文件，说明这些文件的改动在最终被还原或者与 main 相同。

等一下，`git diff main...pr-234` 是 merge-base(main, pr-234) 到 pr-234 的 diff。merge-base 应该是 main 的最新（因为 PR 分支从 main 分出后 main 没有新提交？让我确认一下）。

git log 显示 pr-234 有 6 个提交不在 main 上。merge-base 是 12b8623a... 或者更早的。让我确认 virtualization 文件是否在最终状态与 main 相同。

从 diff --stat 看，14 个文件里没有 virtualization 文件，说明 virtualization 文件最终状态与 merge-base 相同（改动被还原了）。这解释了为什么意见 A 标记为 "Addressed in commit 54e57dc" —— 54e57dc 把错误的 `#ifndef` 改回了 `#ifdef`（还原了）。

也就是说意见 A 和 B（CodeRabbit Major）已经解决：virtualization 测试的改动被撤销，回到 main 的状态。

现在剩下的是意见 C（README 的 SDC_EXTRA_ARGS 命令无效 + 语义错误）和意见 D（用户要求）。

用户要求 D：
1. **13 个测试文件**：PR 删除了 `.fracture_loop_count = -1`（省略字段）。用户要求"显示指定 fracture_loop_count == 0"，即改为显式写 `.fracture_loop_count = 0,`。这样意图明确：使用默认自动 fracture 模式。

   等等，我需要仔细理解用户的话："fracture_loop_count 建议改成默认模式，显示指定 'fracture_loop_count == 0'"

   "改成默认模式" —— PR 已经通过删除 `-1` 实现了默认模式（C 结构体零初始化 → 0 → 自动模式）。用户说"显示指定 fracture_loop_count == 0"（"显示"应为"显式"的笔误）—— 即在代码里显式写 `.fracture_loop_count = 0,` 而不是靠省略。

   这样代码自文档化：明确表达"我们特意选择默认自动 fracture 模式"，而不是"忘了设置"。

2. **README**：用户说"并在readme中（尤其一句话命令的最大化激发SDC），指定 '--max-test-loop-count 参考'为更激进的方式。"

   解读：README 中（尤其"一句话命令的最大化激发SDC"部分），把 `--max-test-loop-count` 的参考/用法标为"更激进的方式"。

   当前 README 中新加的那行是：
   ```
   SDC_EXTRA_ARGS="--max-test-loop-count=0" sudo bash scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/excite.sh # 更激进的激发模式（启用默认的 fracture 自动按需调整机制）
   ```

   问题（CodeRabbit 意见 C）：
   a. `SDC_EXTRA_ARGS` 不被 excite.sh 转发 → 命令无效
   b. `--max-test-loop-count=0` 语义是禁用 fracturing，注释说"启用默认的 fracture 自动按需调整机制"是错的

   用户的意图：保留"更激进方式"的概念，但要用正确的机制表达。

   关键问题：什么才是"更激进的方式"？

   我需要验证：
   - `--max-test-loop-count` 的确切语义（sandstone_opts.cpp 的帮助文本 + sandstone_run.cpp 的实现）
   - `--max-test-loop-count=0` 到底是什么行为
   - excite.sh / sdc-excite-reproduce.sh 如何传参给 sdcshield，是否支持额外参数
   - README 中"一句话命令的最大化激发SDC"的上下文

   然后决定"更激进的方式"的正确表达：
   - 可能是 `--max-test-loop-count`（不带 =0）？或者带某个较小值？
   - 从用户评论中"框架会把内循环设置为一个默认值，文档/代码中为 40"和"auto 模式下在首期短循环会按需把内循环计数翻倍"，`--max-test-loop-count=N` 若指定一个较小的 N 会更频繁 fracture（每个 fragment 更短，fork 更多，种子更多样）→ 更激进？

   等等，让我重新读用户的解释：
   > 如果命令行 --max-test-loop-count 指定则用它；

   所以 `--max-test-loop-count` 覆盖 current_max_loop_count。若指定 0... 用户在评论里说 "fracture_loop_count == 0：默认的'自动'模式（框架会把内循环设置为一个默认值，文档/代码中为 40）"。

   注意：这是 `test->fracture_loop_count == 0`（测试注册时的字段）的语义。但命令行 `--max-test-loop-count=0` 是另一回事 —— 从 CodeRabbit 的分析："that option would disable test fracturing"。

   我需要读代码确认 `--max-test-loop-count=0` 的确切行为。

   另外"更激进"还有一种可能：当前 excite.sh 战役的 sdcshield 调用里可能已经带了 `-t` 或 `-fracture` 相关参数。让我看 sdc-excite-reproduce.sh 怎么调用 sdcshield 的。

#!/bin/bash
# excite.sh — SDC 7×24 战役一键总入口（最大程度激发 SDC 的策略入口）
#
# 把运维手册（docs/sdc-excite-reproduce/operations-runbook.md §1「眼睛先于负载」）
# 的首启序列固化为一条命令：
#   预检（fail-loud）→ 按需安装 systemd 单元 → 起 sdc-monitor（眼睛）→
#   冒烟门（L0 + 战役 smoke，不过不上线）→ 起 sdc-excite-reproduce（负载）→ 状态摘要
#
# 用法:
#   sudo bash scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/excite.sh           # 一键上线 7×24 战役
#   bash  scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/excite.sh --smoke       # 只预检+冒烟（不动 systemd，无需 root）
#   bash  scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/excite.sh --status      # = status.sh（只读巡检）
#   sudo bash scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/excite.sh --stop    # = stop.sh（保留断点）
#
# 设计边界（如实）:
#   - M2 事件栈（root-helper/eventd/controller/ring/采集器）不自动拉起——
#     其基线预置与 PMU 计数器注入是单板相关人工步骤（operations-runbook.md §1）。
#   - 冒烟门以当前用户跑（写 $HOME/sdc-excite-reproduce，一次性验证门），
#     与 systemd 服务用户的正式战役状态目录相互独立——这是刻意的（验证门
#     不污染正式断点 state.json）。
#   - 幂等：已安装/已活跃的服务自动跳过；state.json 断点保留，重复执行安全。
set -euo pipefail
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

usage() { sed -n '2,21p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }

MODE="run"
case "${1:-}" in
    --smoke)  MODE="smoke" ;;
    --status) exec bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/status.sh" ;;
    --stop)   exec bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/stop.sh" ;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    "") ;;
    *) echo "未知参数: $1（--smoke / --status / --stop，见 --help）" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

SUDO=""   # 调用处故意不加引号：为空时整词消失（引号式 "" 会按空命令名执行，rc=127）
ensure_root() { # ensure_root <需要 root 的动作描述>
    if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then return 0; fi
    if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then SUDO="sudo"; return 0; fi
    echo "FATAL: $1 需要 root，且本机无 sudo。可用: su -c '$0 $*'" >&2
    exit 1
}

# ---------------- 1. 预检（fail-loud，全部通过才继续）----------------
source "$SCRIPT_DIR/sdc_common.sh"
ensure_bin   # BIN 缺失即 FATAL 退出（Task 3：仅真正执行 $BIN 的消费者显式调用）
ensure_dirs
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FATAL: 战役驱动需要 python3" >&2; exit 1; }
if [ "$MODE" = "run" ]; then
    command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 \
        || { echo "FATAL: run 模式需要 systemctl（systemd 机器）；冒烟验证可用 --smoke" >&2; exit 1; }
fi
echo "[preflight] sdcshield: $BIN"
# L0 冒烟门：zstd19 单线程回归（CLAUDE.md 规定的最小回归，约 2 秒）
if ! "$BIN" -e zstd19 -t 2000 -n 1 -Y -o /dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "FATAL: L0 冒烟未过（zstd19 -t 2000 -n 1）——先修复构建再上线" >&2
    exit 1
fi
echo "[preflight] L0 冒烟: pass"

# ---------------- 2. 按需安装 systemd 单元（幂等）----------------
if [ "$MODE" = "run" ]; then
    if systemctl list-unit-files sdc-excite-reproduce.service 2>/dev/null \
            | grep -q '^sdc-excite-reproduce\.service'; then
        echo "[install] systemd 单元已就位，跳过"
    else
        ensure_root "安装 systemd 单元"
        echo "[install] systemd 单元缺失，执行 install.sh"
        $SUDO bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/install.sh"
    fi

    # ---------------- 3. 眼睛先于负载：起 sdc-monitor ----------------
    if $SUDO systemctl is-active --quiet sdc-monitor.service; then
        echo "[monitor] sdc-monitor 已活跃，跳过"
    else
        ensure_root "启动 sdc-monitor（联锁眼睛）"
        echo "[monitor] 启动 sdc-monitor（温度/内存/磁盘/SEL 联锁）"
        $SUDO systemctl start sdc-monitor.service
    fi

content.text:
Base directory for this skill: /home/sdc/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/superpowers/6.3.0/skills/writing-plans

# Writing Plans

## Overview

Write comprehensive implementation plans assuming the engineer has zero context for our codebase and questionable taste. Document everything they need to know: which files to touch for each task, code, testing, docs they might need to check, how to test it. Give them the whole plan as bite-sized tasks. DRY. YAGNI. TDD. Frequent commits.

Assume they are a skilled developer, but know almost nothing about our toolset or problem domain. Assume they don't know good test design very well.

**Announce at start:** "I'm using the writing-plans skill to create the implementation plan."

**Context:** If working in an isolated worktree, it should have been created via the `superpowers:using-git-worktrees` skill at execution time.

**Save plans to:** `docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<feature-name>.md`
- (User preferences for plan location override this default)

## Scope Check

If the spec covers multiple independent subsystems, it should have been broken into sub-project specs during brainstorming. If it wasn't, suggest breaking this into separate plans — one per subsystem. Each plan should produce working, testable software on its own.

## File Structure

Before defining tasks, map out which files will be created or modified and what each one is responsible for. This is where decomposition decisions get locked in.

- Design units with clear boundaries and well-defined interfaces. Each file should have one clear responsibility.
- You reason best about code you can hold in context at once, and your edits are more reliable when files are focused. Prefer smaller, focused files over large ones that do too much.
- Files that change together should live together. Split by responsibility, not by technical layer.
- In existing codebases, follow established patterns. If the codebase uses large files, don't unilaterally restructure - but if a file you're modifying has grown unwieldy, including a split in the plan is reasonable.

This structure informs the task decomposition. Each task should produce self-contained changes that make sense independently.

## Task Right-Sizing

A task is the smallest unit that carries its own test cycle and is worth a
fresh reviewer's gate. When drawing task boundaries: fold setup,
configuration, scaffolding, and documentation steps into the task whose
deliverable needs them; split only where a reviewer could meaningfully
reject one task while approving its neighbor. Each task ends with an
independently testable deliverable.

## Bite-Sized Task Granularity

**Each step is one action (2-5 minutes):**
- "Write the failing test" - step
- "Run it to make sure it fails" - step
- "Implement the minimal code to make the test pass" - step
- "Run the tests and make sure they pass" - step
- "Commit" - step

## Plan Document Header

**Every plan MUST start with this header:**

```markdown
# [Feature Name] Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** [One sentence describing what this builds]

**Architecture:** [2-3 sentences about approach]

**Tech Stack:** [Key technologies/libraries]

**Spec:** [path to the spec/design doc this plan implements — the plan
argues from the spec, so the spec travels with it; executors read both]

## Global Constraints

[The spec's project-wide requirements — version floors, dependency limits,
naming and copy rules, platform requirements — one line each, with exact
values copied verbatim from the spec. Every task's requirements implicitly
include this section.]

---
```

## Task Structure

````markdown
### Task N: [Component Name]

**Files:**
- Create: `exact/path/to/file.py`
- Modify: `exact/path/to/existing.py:123-145`
- Test: `tests/exact/path/to/test.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: [what this task uses from earlier tasks — exact signatures]
- Produces: [what later tasks rely on — exact function names, parameter
  and return types. A task's implementer sees only their own task; this
  block is how they learn the names and types neighboring tasks use.]

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```python
def test_specific_behavior():
    result = function(input)
    assert result == expected
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run test to verify it fails**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: FAIL with "function not defined"

- [ ] **Step 3: Write minimal implementation**

```python
def function(input):
    return expected
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run test to verify it passes**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: PASS

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**

```bash
git add tests/path/test.py src/path/file.py
git commit -m "feat: add specific feature"
```
````

## No Placeholders

Every step must contain the actual content an engineer needs. These are **plan failures** — never write them:
- "TBD", "TODO", "implement later", "fill in details"
- "Add appropriate error handling" / "add validation" / "handle edge cases"
- "Write tests for the above" (without actual test code)
- "Similar to Task N" (repeat the code — the engineer may be reading tasks out of order)
- Steps that describe what to do without showing how (code blocks required for code steps)
- References to types, functions, or methods not defined in any task

## Self-Review

After writing the complete plan, look at the spec with fresh eyes and check the plan against it. This is a checklist you run yourself — not a subagent dispatch.

**1. Spec coverage:** Skim each section/requirement in the spec. Can you point to a task that implements it? List any gaps.

**2. Placeholder scan:** Search your plan for red flags — any of the patterns from the "No Placeholders" section above. Fix them.

**3. Type consistency:** Do the types, method signatures, and property names you used in later tasks match what you defined in earlier tasks? A function called `clearLayers()` in Task 3 but `clearFullLayers()` in Task 7 is a bug.

If you find issues, fix them inline. No need to re-review — just fix and move on. If you find a spec requirement with no task, add the task.

## Execution Handoff

After saving the plan, offer execution choice:

**"Plan complete and saved to `docs/superpowers/plans/<filename>.md`. Two execution options:**

**1. Subagent-Driven (recommended)** - I dispatch a fresh subagent per task, review between tasks, fast iteration

**2. Inline Execution** - Execute tasks in this session using executing-plans, batch execution with checkpoints

**Which approach?"**

**If Subagent-Driven chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development
- Fresh subagent per task + two-stage review

**If Inline Execution chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:executing-plans
- Batch execution with checkpoints for review

等等！meson.build 的注释和 b2facced 的提交说明有出入：

- b2facced 提交说明（2026-09-20）说："These files contain ARM inline asm (mrs midr_el1/cntvct, dc civac, yield) so they never compiled on x86-64; the wrap makes that explicit."
- meson.build 注释（当前，main）说："The other 8 files are plain C++ with ARM64 inline asm (mrs/dc/yield) and __sync_synchronize() fences, no x86 intrinsics, and build on all arches."（其余 8 个文件是纯 C++ + ARM64 内联汇编，无 x86 intrinsics，**在所有架构上构建**）

矛盾？如果 8 个文件"build on all arches"，那 x86-64 构建会编译它们 → x86 分支（#else，含 mrs/yield 的 ARM64 asm）→ x86 构建失败！

等等，不对。让我重新理解 b2facced 后的文件结构：
- `#ifdef __aarch64__` → skip（ARM64 上）
- `#else` → 模拟路径（**含 ARM64 内联汇编** mrs/yield）

x86-64 编译时：`#else` 分支被编译 → 里面的 `__asm__ volatile("mrs %0, midr_el1")` 是 ARM64 汇编 → x86-64 上编译失败！

# AGENTS.md

本文件为 AI 代码检视代理提供 SDCShield 仓库级指令：任何变更在合入前，都必须通过下列规则与「SDC 激发能力」检视。

## 仓库概览

SDCShield 是 Intel OpenDCDiag 的 ARM64 移植版，用于检测**静默数据损坏（SDC, Silent Data
Corruption）**——即计算不崩溃、但产生错误比特。其检测原理是：压测目标计算单元（FMA、SIMD、
压缩、SVD、crypto），再与预先算好的 golden 值做**字节级比较**。

- **参考架构**：x86-64（**未改动**，作为移植正确性的对照基线）。
- **目标架构**：ARM64，面向 Kunpeng 920 / ARMv8.1+。
- **比对原则**：golden 比较是字节级 `memcmp`，浮点结果必须可复现。

## 关键规则

1. **golden 比对必须字节级、且浮点可复现**：比对使用 `memcmp`（或封装 `memcmp_or_fail`）。
   浮点输出必须逐位可复现——框架已在 `sandstone_data.cpp` 统一 quiet SNaN，以保证 FP16/BF16
   的 NaN 位型跨架构一致。任何引入架构相关浮点差异的改动都视为缺陷。
2. **x86-64 非回归（增量式移植）**：移植必须附加式实现，使用 `#elif __aarch64__` 与按架构的
   meson 守卫；只有在**确实共享**的代码路径上，才可把 `#ifdef __x86_64__` 扩展为同时包含
   `__aarch64__`。禁止无理由地改写 x86-64 已有逻辑。
3. **诚实性——禁止假通过**：ARM64 上尚未实现的功能，必须从 `test_init` 返回 `EXIT_SKIP`，
   且跳过理由为 `"to be implemented (placeholder): <缺失内容>"`；**禁止**用 `EXIT_SUCCESS`
   伪装通过（no-op 测试报 pass 是 bug）。`mce_check` 在 ARM64 是真实的 EDAC 后端测试，**必须通过**。
4. **一个补丁一个单元**：每个特性 / 修复 / 移植点单独提交，**不得捆绑**多个单元。提交遵循 DCO：
   `git commit -s`，`Signed-off-by` 为最后一行，其后不得再有内容。
5. **文档同步**：大颗粒度修改必须同步更新 `README.md` 与 `docs/` 下对应文档，确保内容 100% 准确。

## 代码检视重点：SDC 激发能力

SDC 检视的独特之处在于——不仅看代码「对不对」，更看它**是否真的能把计算单元逼出错比特**。
评审时请逐条核查以下 6 项：

1. **激发强度与覆盖**
   - 是否真正压到目标计算单元（FMA / SIMD / 压缩 / SVD / crypto），而非只调用一次即返回？
   - 数据宽度是否覆盖目标位宽（如 128/256/512-bit 向量、FP16/BF16/FP32/FP64）？
   - 数据模式是否多样（随机、全 0/全 1、边界值、NaN/Inf、极值），以避免被单一模式掩盖的缺陷？
   - `TEST_LOOP` 的定时压力是否充足，能否在给定时长内持续打满目标单元？

2. **golden 比对**
   - 是否使用字节级 `memcmp` 而非近似/容差比较？
   - 浮点是否逐位可复现（SNaN/NaN 位型跨架构一致，依赖框架在 `sandstone_data.cpp` 的 quiet 处理）？

3. **正确性基线（x86-64 非回归）**
   - 是否以 `#elif __aarch64__` / 按架构 meson 守卫的方式增量添加，未破坏 x86-64 参考路径？
   - 是否**不当扩大** `#ifdef __x86_64__`？只有在代码真正跨架构共享时才允许扩展。

4. **诚实性**
   - ARM64 未实现项是否返回 `EXIT_SKIP` 且理由为 `"to be implemented (placeholder): ..."`？
   - 是否存在以 `EXIT_SUCCESS` 假通过的 no-op 测试？

5. **架构相关缺陷（SVE/NEON VL）**
   - 是否存在与向量长度（VL）相关的越界读写或误报？
   - 注意：CI runner 的 VL=128 会掩盖 512-bit VL 下的缺陷，需人工确认更高 VL 下的正确性。

6. **失败现场留存**
   - 失败路径是否保留冷路径的 bit dump、sum-bit、failing-vector 记录，以便复现与定位？
   - 是否因过早返回而丢弃了足以定位故障的现场信息？

## 延伸阅读

- [`CLAUDE.md`](CLAUDE.md) — 仓库协作与工程规则总纲。
- [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md) — 框架内部（fork 生命周期、质量门、特性探测、sysdeps、RAS、RNG）。
- [`docs/misc/writing_tests.md`](docs/misc/writing_tests.md) — 测试编写指南。
- [`docs/misc/coding_style_guide.md`](docs/misc/coding_style_guide.md) — 代码风格（C++20/C17，无警告）。
- [`README.md`](README.md) — 快速上手、构建与部署。

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** (A) 把 main 的 CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md 合并进 PR 分支；(B) 让 `sme_fmopa_stress_arm`、`sme_za_tileview_arm`、`sve512_stencil_axis_arm`、`fpu_special_values_sve` 的输入随框架种子随机化，使 fracture 换片段时输入组合真正变化（解决 greptile 4254737399 与用户指示）。

**Architecture:** 随机源统一用框架 RNG（`frandomf_scale`/`random32`/`random64`，sandstone.h:570-587）——绑定 `-s` 种子与 fracture 的 `random_advance_seed()`，日志 seed 可复现（优于 fma_sve 的 `std::random_device`）。每个测试在**保持自身数值约束与 golden 自洽性**的前提下随机化：

- **fmopa**：操作数改 `frandomf_scale(1.125f) - 0.5625f`（\|a\|,\|b\|<0.5625，64 步和 <21 约束保持）；golden 本就同源 fmaf 重算，不动。
- **za_tileview**：`(random64()%1024)*64 + (i*n+j)` —— 精确整数 + 8×8 网格严格单射（错位可检测性保持）；golden 是排列派生，不动。
- **stencil**：src 改 `1 + random32()%256`（精确小整数）；解析 expected `1.5×iterations×(j+1)` 换成运行时标量参考（同 r/双向结构重算增量×iterations）。精确性论证：0.125×整数、12 项、×1e8 全部 < 2⁵³ 且在 2⁻³ 网格 → 加法顺序无关、bit-exact 保持。
- **fpu_special**：固定 12 IEEE 特殊值**不动**（测试语义），表扩 4 个随机有限值（`±frandomf_scale(1.0f)`，f64 同理）→ NUM_SPECIALS 12→16，穷举 16³；表在 run 开头构建 → 每片段新组合。

**Tech Stack:** C++20、meson/ninja、框架 RNG（framework/random.cpp thread_local_rng）。

**Spec:** 用户指示 + greptile 4254737399；先例 `tests/cpu/arm64/neon_rot_2src.cpp`（init 里 memset_random）。

## Global Constraints

- DCO 尾行 `Signed-off-by: wangxu <wangxumarshall@qq.com>`；push 到 `jules-6179826238522825613-c1296a5b`（本地分支 `pr-234-new`）。
- 自验证 100% 真实：本机 4 测试全部 skip（CpuNotSupported）→ 运行时行为以**独立逻辑验证程序**实证（/tmp，不进仓库）+ 构建零警告 + zstd19 回归；SVE/SME 目标机行为如实声明未验证。
- x86 非回归：4 文件均在 `tests/cpu/arm64/`、`tests/cpu/sve/`（per-arch meson 目标），by inspection。
- golden 字节比较语义不得破坏（各测试的精确性论证见上）。

---

### Task A: 合并 main 的 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md

- [ ] `git checkout origin/main -- AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md`（CLAUDE.md 无差异、AGENTS.md 67 行新增；其"延伸阅读"首条即 CLAUDE.md 引用，满足"引用 CLAUDE.md"要求）
- [ ] `git diff --cached --stat` 确认仅 AGENTS.md +67
- [ ] commit -s（`docs: merge AGENTS.md (AI review-agent guide, references CLAUDE.md) from main`）+ push

### Task B: 4 测试种子随机化

**Files（Modify）：**
- `tests/cpu/arm64/sme_fmopa_stress_arm.cpp`（init 数据生成 ~168-176 行）
- `tests/cpu/arm64/sme_za_tileview_arm.cpp`（init 数据生成，`a[ij]/b[ij]` 公式）
- `tests/cpu/arm64/sve512_stencil_axis_arm.cpp`（init src 生成 + run 的 expected 标量参考化）
- `tests/cpu/sve/fma2/fpu_special_values_sve.cpp`（NUM_SPECIALS 12→16 + build_specials 追加随机项）

- [ ] Step 1: 逐文件实施上述四项修改（含注释更新，说明随机源与约束保持）
- [ ] Step 2: `ninja -C builddir` 零警告构建
- [ ] Step 3: 独立逻辑验证程序（/tmp/rand_verify.cpp，mt19937 模拟 RNG 验证公式结构）：
  - 两个不同"种子"→ 4 组测试数据均不同（随机性生效）
  - fmopa：\|a\|,\|b\|<0.5625 断言 + 软件重算 golden == golden 数组
  - za_tileview：64 元素严格 distinct + 整数精确
  - stencil：**退化验证**——固定 {1..16} src 下，新标量参考 == 原解析式 `1.5×iterations×(j+1)`（证明参考实现正确）；随机 src 下 expected 为 2⁻³ 网格精确值
  - fpu_special：4 随机值有限、\|v\|<1、非 NaN
- [ ] Step 4: zstd19 回归 `exit: pass`
- [ ] Step 5: commit -s（一个 feature 单元：seed-dependent inputs for fracture diversity，message 分测试说明设计）+ push
- [ ] Step 6: 回复 greptile 4254737399 线程（随机化已落地）

## Self-Review

- 用户两项要求全覆盖（AGENTS.md 合并 / 4 测试随机化）✓
- 每测试的数值约束、golden 自洽、bit-exact 论证齐备 ✓
- 验证路径明确（本机 skip 的诚实处置：独立逻辑实证 + 目标机声明）✓

1	# SDCShield
2	
3	SDCShield is an open-source project designed to identify defects and bugs in ARM CPUs derived from Intel's OpenDCDiag (ARM64 port). It consists of a set of tests built around a sophisticated CPU testing framework.
4	
5	## Origin
6	
7	SDCShield is derived from OpenDCDiag (which contains the Intel `sandstone` framework), licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE). See [NOTICE](NOTICE) for full derivation and upstream provenance.
8	
9	## 一行命令检测鲲鹏 CPU SDC（傻瓜化）
10	
11	**源码树（推荐）**：
12	
13	```bash
14	bash scripts/run/sdc_detect.sh
15	```
16	
17	**预构建二进制**（需 2026-10-09 之后由 `scripts/offline-build/package-built-artifacts.sh` 打包、随包 `sdc_detect.sh` 的版本，`detect` 子命令自动调用它；CI tarball 与旧包未含——用下方等效命令。获取与进入目录见下节「直接运行预构建二进制」）：
18	
19	```bash
20	./run-sdcshield.sh detect
21	```
22	
23	**冒烟自检**（约 35 秒，验证链路与优先序）：`bash scripts/run/sdc_detect.sh --smoke`
24	
25	**脚本使用方法**：`bash scripts/run/sdc_detect.sh [--smoke] [透传参数…]`（`-h`/`--help` 看完整帮助）。
26	
27	| 项 | 说明 |
28	|---|---|
29	| `--smoke` | 冒烟自检：每桶前 2 用例各 2 秒的单遍运行（约 35 秒），验证链路与优先序 |
30	| 透传参数 | 其余参数原样交给 sdcshield（如 `-t 30s`、`--cpuset 0-47`） |
31	| `SDC_BIN` 环境变量 | 显式指定二进制；默认依次发现 `./builddir/sdcshield`、`./builddir-gcc/sdcshield`，找不到即报错退出并给出构建指引 |
32	| 产物 | 当前目录留下 `sdc-detect-testlist-*.txt`（本次优先序名单，可复现）与 `sdc-detect-*.yaml`（日志） |
33	| 停止 | Ctrl-C 干净停止；检出 FAIL 自动停（`-F`） |
34	
35	**优先序机制**：脚本从当前二进制动态生成优先序测试列表（框架 `--test-list-file`，顺序即执行序，对新用例自适应），先跑 SDC 敏感度最高的负载：
36	
37	| 优先级 | 负载域 | 依据 |
38	|---|---|---|
39	| P1 | 向量 FMA/矩阵（GEMM/SVD/SLEEF/FFT/sve512-f 链） | SEVI(ASPLOS'26)：>92% SDC 事故由 FMA 指令贡献 |
40	| P2 | ARM64 SDC 专项（LSU/OoO/L2 跨行/di-t/sve512 上下文） | 本仓库为已知鲲鹏故障签名定向编写 |
41	| P3 | memcpy/store→reload 访存通路 | CPU179 实证触发判别条件 |
42	| P4 | 位扩散（压缩/哈希/CRC/加密） | From Gates to SDCs(DATE'25)：sha 类位掩蔽最少 |
43	| P5 | 标量浮点/大整数 | — |
44	| P6 | 一致性/原子/SIMD | 控制流类故障多 crash 化，SDC 倾向低 |
45	| P7 | 其余（字母序） | 完整多样性保留 |
46	
47	**命令逐项解释**（脚本已内建，无需手输；其余参数原样透传，如 `-t 30s`、`--cpuset`）：
48	
49	| 旗标 | 作用 |
50	|---|---|
51	| `--quality=0` | 跑 PROD+BETA 全部 446 用例（源码构建口径；预构建二进制为 225 例、一轮约 3.75 小时——少的是 vendored 计算库测试组，见下节口径说明）。**必须加**：BETA 级 `arm64_sdc`（di/dt 电压骤降专项）等 6 个用例不加此旗标会被跳过（实测 skip 并提示） |
52	| `--test-list-file` | 优先序测试列表：由脚本从当前二进制动态生成（顺序即执行序，对新用例自适应） |
53	| `-T forever` | 整套用例无限轮转。SDC 故障窗口极稀疏（CPU179 实测占空比 ~0.06%），长驻留是检出关键；一轮 ≈ 7 小时 |
54	| `-t 60s` | 每用例 60 秒。SEVI 实测 >80% 的首错在 10 秒内出现，60s 有 6 倍余量 |
55	| `-Y` | 结构化 YAML 日志（取证格式） |
56	| `-F` | 首个 FAIL 即停——停下就是信号。SKIP 不算失败，占位用例不会误停 |
57	| `-o sdc-detect-*.yaml` | 日志落盘为固定文件名（便于归档取证）。不带 `-o` 时框架会在当前目录自动生成 `sdcshield-<UTC时间戳>.yaml`，文件名不可预测；且全过退出（exit: pass）时该文件被自动删除，仅失败/中断时留存 |
58	
59	**等效命令（无脚本时；注意：默认注册序无优先级）**——不带 `--test-list-file` 时框架按默认注册序执行，SDC 敏感负载不会先跑：
60	
61	```bash
62	# 源码构建
63	./builddir/sdcshield --quality=0 -T forever -t 60s -Y -F -o sdc-$(date +%m%d-%H%M).yaml
64	# 预构建二进制（旧 tarball；clone 后进入对应 SP 的 built 目录）
65	./run-sdcshield.sh --quality=0 -T forever -t 60s -Y -F -o sdc-$(date +%m%d-%H%M).yaml
66	```
67	
68	**为什么是这条命令**：CPU179 故障核的实证——优先序全套件全核轮转约 100 秒出首错，而单测试单跑（含 11180 个 seed 轮换）零复现。全核并发 + 负载多样性 + 长驻留三者齐备才有检出率，这条命令一次配齐。
69	
70	**结果判读**：
71	
72	1. **一直跑不停** = 本轮全过；`-T forever` 自动进入下一轮，继续挂着（检出率随时间积累）。
73	2. **停下且有 FAIL**：先看挂在哪个测试——
74	   - 挂在 `eigen_svd_double` / `eigen_sparse`：大核数机器全核多线程下的已知 ULP 级良性抖动。用 `-e <测试名> -t 5000 -n 1` 单线程复跑（源码树 `./builddir/sdcshield`、预构建 `./run-sdcshield.sh`）：**单线程过 = 良性**（假阳性），单线程也挂 = 真嫌疑。
75	   - 挂在其他任何测试：**SDC 嫌疑**。保留 `-o` 落盘的 YAML 日志（含 seed/迭代号，可复现），进入定位流程。
76	3. **停止方式**：Ctrl-C 干净停止（当前测试跑完边界即停，日志完整落盘，`exit: interrupted`）。
77	4. **检出后的定位**：`bash scripts/run/run_sdc_campaign.sh`（24h 战役，自动失败分类 known_benign_ulp / sdc_suspect + 可复现嫌疑自动逐核二分定位）。
78	
79	## 一键最大程度激发 SDC（7×24 战役总入口）
80

82	sudo bash scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/excite.sh          # 一键上线 7×24 战役
83	bash  scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/excite.sh --smoke      # 只预检+冒烟（无需 root）

86	```

89	fracturing，测试窗口内不再换种子重启，固定种子单模式连续运行（CORE179 类单模式持续
90	暴露；选项语义见 `docs/research/usage.md`）。战役 L4 深驻留阶段已内置该模式；以深驻留

98	**使用方法要点**（`excite.sh -h` 看完整帮助）：`--smoke` 模式无需 root、不触碰 systemd（预检 + 战役冒烟门）；run 模式需 root（sudo），幂等可重入——已安装/已活跃的服务自动跳过，`state.json` 断点保留，重复执行安全。环境变量：`SDC_BIN` 指定 sdcshield 二进制；`SMOKE_TIMEOUT_S` 覆盖战役冒烟门上限（默认 2400 秒；冒烟为 L1-L5 短时长单遍，实测约 23 分钟，L5 专项每次轮换一支分支——慢板机器可调大）。

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## What this is


## Build & run


## Architecture

## Writing fi

## Patch discipline (feature/porting/bug/adapter)

This repository enforces a strict one-patch-per-unit workflow. Apply it to **every** change, including ARM64 porting points, feature development, bug fixes, and architecture adapters.

### One patch per unit

Each feature, functionality point, bug, or adaptation point is its own commit. Never bundle unrelated changes into one commit. A "unit" means a single coherent item from a work list (e.g. "#13 uncore frequency exit bug" is one patch; "#12 thermal monitor" is the next). When a task spans several numbered points, solve them **one at a time, sequentially** — finish one (verify → commit → push) before starting the next. Do not parallelize or batch.

### Self-verification before commit (mandatory, 100% real)

After writing code and before committing, the AI **must verify itself** with real commands — no claims based on "it should work" or reading the diff. Specifically:

1. **Build clean**: any warning/error introduced by the change is a failure.
2. **Functional verification**: run the actual affected behavior with real commands and capture real output. Quote the real observed output as proof, not a prediction.
3. **Regression check**: run at least one unaffected test and confirm `exit: pass`, zero SIGSEGV, to prove no collateral breakage.

Do **not** commit if any of these fail. If a verification step fails, fix and re-verify until it passes. Skipping verification or fabricating results ("assumed to pass") is strictly forbidden — every claim in the commit message must correspond to a command the AI actually ran.

### Auto-push to a non-main branch after verification

Once a patch is committed and verified, **push it automatically to the remote** — do not wait to be asked, and do not push to `main`. Work on a feature branch (e.g. `fix/mce-check-arm64-null-test-run`) and `git push` after each commit. If on `main` when starting work, create/switch to a feature branch first (`git checkout -b <branch>`) before committing.

Commit message must not end with:
```
Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
```
### Plan-driven workflow (mandatory for every non-trivial change)

All non-trivial work — feature development, porting, refactors, multi-step fixes, anything beyond a single obvious line — **must** be executed via a written plan using the `superpowers:writing-plans` skill, not ad-hoc. "Trivial" means a typo or a one-line obvious fix the change itself describes completely.

1. **Plan first**: before writing any code, invoke `superpowers:writing-plans` and save the plan to `docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<feature>.md`. The plan defines one-patch-per-unit decomposition, exact files, real test commands, and per-step checkboxes (`- [ ]`).
2. **Plan == the work list**: each plan task maps to exactly one commit, satisfying "One patch per unit" above. Do not bundle multiple plan tasks into one commit, and do not commit work not in the plan.
3. **Track progress visibly**: implement via `superpowers:subagent-driven-development` (recommended) or `superpowers:executing-plans`. Check off each `- [ ]` as it completes; the live plan file is the single source of truth for what is done vs pending. If the scope changes mid-execution, edit the plan file first, then proceed.
4. **Verify against the plan, not the diff**: the self-verification above applies per task; a task is not "done" until its plan-specified verification command's real output is quoted and its checkbox is checked.
5. **Provenance**: keep plan files in the repo under `docs/superpowers/plans/` (they document *why* a change was made one unit at a time, complementing git history).

If a request would produce more than one commit, write the plan first. No plan, no code.

Each feature, functionality point, bug, or adaptation point is its own commit. Never bundle unrelated changes into one commit. 2. **Functional verification**: run the actual affected behavior with real commands and capture real output. Quote the real observed output as proof, not a prediction.
3. **Regression check**: run at least one unaffected test and confirm `exit: pass`, zero SIGSEGV, to prove no collateral breakage.

- ArmSystem 有 `sve_vl`/`sme_vl` 参数（quadword 单位）与 Armv92（FEAT_SME）特性集

**缺口（本任务要建的）**：
1. `arm_chaos.py` 不设置 sve_vl/sme_vl/extension（stdlib SimpleBoard 的 ArmSystem 默认特性集——需要确认默认值并加 CLI 参数）

- L1 仿真可运行性：4 kernel 在 VL=512/SVL=512（SME）下无注入跑通（golden 自洽）
- L2 SDC 检出能力：注入（PhysReg vector lane / FPU）→ kernel 检出（输出 ≠ 基线）→ 分类 SDC/Masked
- L3 随机化多样性效果（PR #237 的核心主张）：同注入配置下 fixed-input kernel vs random-input kernel 的检出差异——具体实验设计：
  a. 同一注入点（target/lane/bit/触发窗口固定），fixed kernel 的结果 vs random kernel 多 seed 的结果
  b. 度量：检出率（SDC 比例）与检出位面（哪些 bit/lane 的注入被检出）
  c. 预期：fixed 输入在特定注入下 Masked（数据未覆盖），random 换 seed 后部分检出——多样性收益的直接实证

**先做决定性 pilot（写计划前）**：最小 SVE512 汇编程序 + 最小 SME 程序在 gem5 O3 上能否跑。这决定 4 个 kernel 里哪些可行：

- sve512_stencil_axis（SVE VL=512 svmla/ld1）—— 需要 sve_vl=4，大概率 ✓
- sme_fmopa_stress（SME FMOPA + SMSTART/ZA）—— sme.isa 有指令，但 O3 + streaming mode 状态切换？未知，需实测

理解这个新要求：gem5 仿真验证不要只覆盖 VL=512（sve512 测试所需），而要把 SVE 的各种向量长度（128/256/512/1024 bit）和 SME 的 SVL 规格都支持起来——即 SE 配置（arm_chaos.py 或新配置）要能参数化设置 sve_vl/sme_vl，覆盖所有规格。这样：
1. PR #237 的 4 个测试在各自所需 VL（512）验证
2. 其他 VL 规格也能跑（fpu_special 任意 VL；stencil 需要 512；未来测试的覆盖）
3. "所有版本、规格"—— SVE：VL 128/256/512/1024（2^n 格式，quadword 单位 1/2/4/8）；SME：SVL 同样 128..1024。还有 SVE2/SVE2p1 等特性版本？用户说"所有版本、规格"——合理解读：向量长度规格全覆盖 + 特性集（SVE/SVE2/SME）可切换。务实做法：配置参数化 sve_vl（1/2/4/8 quadwords）+ 特性集（Armv9.x with FEAT_SVE2/FEAT_SME），一个配置入口覆盖全部组合。

# SDCShield 检测效果 gem5 故障注入评估——实现计划

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 通过 CHAOS/gem5 故障注入量化 SDCShield 测试用例的 SDC 检出率 `P_detect = Detected/(Detected+Escape)` 与盲区分布，回答"哪些微架构故障形态 sdcshield 查得出来、哪些静默漏过"。

**Architecture:** 双模式混合设计。**SE-O3 主战场**：把 sdcshield 测试用例提取为静态双通道内核（通道 A = 原测试内部校验，检出=Detected；通道 B = 独立全状态 checksum，判别 Escape/Masked），跑 19 注入器全量位点 × 瞬态/永久故障模型 × N=400 战役。**FS 保真验证臂**：真 sdcshield 二进制装入 gem5-fs Ubuntu 磁盘，经 fs_checkpoint 两阶段流水线在真实 Linux 上接受 TLB/PTW/SysReg/Cache/Mem 注入（小 N 交叉验证）。

**Tech Stack:** CHAOS/gem5 25.1.0.1（ArmO3CPU SE + ArmBoard FS checkpoint，注入器 21+1 类）；sdcshield 子模块 07be34e2（只读，不改其源码）；tools/{runner,campaign,classify}.py 战役工具链；静态 aarch64 C 内核（宿主 openEuler 24.03 SP3 aarch64 原生编译）。

## Global Constraints（全任务隐含遵守）

- **一补丁一单元**：每个 Task = 恰好一个 commit；不捆绑、不并行；完成一个（验证→commit→push）再下一个。
- **三步真机自验证**：干净构建/零新警告 + 功能验证引用真实输出 + 至少一个不相关回归（既有内核 golden 不变：`reg_chain` `f247ef3fe6f02cfd`）。
- **分支纪律**：在 `fi-wx-verify-sdcshield` 分支工作并 push（绝不 push main）；commit 不得以 `Co-Authored-By: Claude` 结尾。
- **sdcshield 子模块只读**：本计划不改 sdcshield 源码（其 CLAUDE.md 有 DCO/CI 门槛）；提取式内核放本仓 `workloads/sdcshield/`。
- **gem5.opt 全量前置**：本仓 `CHAOS/gem5/build/ARM/gem5.opt`（2026-08-27）只含 7 个 CHAOS 类，**Task 0.1 完成前任何注入实验无效**；产物拷贝纪律：scons 产物落仓库根 `build/` 须 cp 回 `CHAOS/gem5/build/ARM/`；**campaign 与构建绝不并行**。

- **超时口径**：runner `CHAOS_HANG_TIMEOUT`（默认 600s）；每个新内核先标定 ITERS 使 gem5 O3 单跑 ≤120s。
- **不改 x86 路径；不改 19 注入器既有语义**（新代码只加 oracle/路由/配置参数）。

## 预注册判据（J1–J4，裁决时不得改）

- **J1（工具有效性）**：全部双通道内核无注入对照（N=20/内核）100% 全绿——`SDCSHIELD_FAILS=0` 且 checksum==golden 且 exit 0。任何失败=FP 底噪，必须先归因清零再进主战役。
- **J2（瞬态到达性检出）**：fpu_special_values 类（常量 golden 逐字节比对）预期 `P_detect → 1.0`；fma 类（in-run `fmaf` 参考 + 1e-6 容差）预期 mantissa 位段 `P_detect` 显著低于 sign/exp 位段（容差盲区预言）。若 fma 类整体 `P_detect` 显著 <1，即发现真实容差/校验窗口盲区——两个方向都是有效结论，如实裁决。
- **J3（永久故障盲区，补 harp_wrap deferred 缺口）**：CHAOSFUPerm × fma 类的 `P_detect` **低于** CHAOSFPU 瞬态 × fma 类（Wilson CI 不重叠为显著）。预言依据：in-run 参考双通道同损（tools/harp_wrap.py:142-145 已登记的结构性弱点，SDCED-7.1 permanent 子臂从未跑过）。

# Source this:  source ~/gem5-deps/env.sh
#
# CRITICAL: do NOT put ~/gem5-deps/usr/bin on PATH — it contains an extracted
# ld/as/ar from the binutils RPM whose library search paths don't include the
# system /usr/lib64, so every -l<lib> configure probe (librt, etc.) fails to
# link. Use the system /usr/bin/ld instead. We only need ~/gem5-deps/py/usr/bin
# (protoc, python3-config, no ld) from the user prefix.
DEPS="$HOME/gem5-deps"
export PATH="$DEPS/py/usr/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/sbin"
export PYTHONPATH="$DEPS/usr/lib/python3.11/site-packages:$DEPS/py/usr/lib/python3.11/site-packages:$DEPS/py/usr/lib64/python3.11/site-packages${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
export CPATH="$DEPS/usr/include:$DEPS/py/usr/include${CPATH:+:$CPATH}"
export LIBRARY_PATH="$DEPS/usr/lib64:$DEPS/py/usr/lib64:/usr/lib64${LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LIBRARY_PATH}"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$DEPS/usr/lib64:$DEPS/py/usr/lib64:/usr/lib64${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$DEPS/usr/lib64/pkgconfig:$DEPS/py/usr/lib64/pkgconfig${PKG_CONFIG_PATH:+:$PKG_CONFIG_PATH}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# verify_gem5_injectors.sh — SVE/SME FI evaluation precondition check.
# Verifies (1) the gem5.opt binary carries the full 19-injector CHAOS set
# (python objects import works — the 2026-08-29 binary had a broken
# embedded registration), (2) the reg_chain golden anchor, (3) SVE/SME
# instruction executability (probe binary, default VL/SVL=128-bit).
# Usage: bash tools/verify_gem5_injectors.sh
set -u
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
source ~/gem5-deps/env.sh
G5=CHAOS/gem5/build/ARM/gem5.opt
RC=0

# --- 1. injector classes (nm symbol table; python import is proven by the
#        anchor runs below — a binary with a broken embedded python registry
#        fails at arm_chaos.py import time) ---
CLASSES="CHAOSReg CHAOSPhysReg CHAOSMem CHAOSCache CHAOSLSQFwd CHAOSAddrPath \
         CHAOSPTW CHAOSRenameMap CHAOSFreeList CHAOSROB CHAOSIQ CHAOSRAS \
         CHAOSExec CHAOSFPU CHAOSL1DForward CHAOSBPU CHAOSExMon CHAOSArmTLB \
         CHAOSArmSysReg"
N=$(nm -C "$G5" 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '^\S+ [TW] gem5::CHAOS(Reg|PhysReg|Mem|Cache|LSQFwd|AddrPath|PTW|RenameMap|FreeList|ROB|IQ|RAS|Exec|FPU|L1DForward|BPU|ExMon|ArmTLB|ArmSysReg)Params')
echo "injector param classes found: $N (expect >= 19)"
[ "$N" -ge 19 ] || { echo "FAIL: injector class count"; RC=1; }

# --- 2. reg_chain golden anchor (no injection, O3) ---
OUT=$(mktemp -d)
A1=$(timeout 300 "$G5" --quiet --outdir="$OUT" configs/se/arm_chaos.py \
     --cpu O3 --cmd workloads/directed/reg_chain --workload_args "200" \
     2>/dev/null | grep -oE '^[0-9a-f]{16}$' | tail -1)
echo "anchor1 reg_chain: ${A1:-<none>} (expect f247ef3fe6f02cfd)"
[ "$A1" = "f247ef3fe6f02cfd" ] || { echo "FAIL: reg_chain golden"; RC=1; }

# --- 3. SVE/SME executability anchor (default VL/SVL = 128-bit) ---
PROBE=workloads/sdcshield/sve_sme_probe
if [ ! -x "$PROBE" ]; then
    echo "anchor3: probe $PROBE missing — building from /tmp cache if present"
    if [ -x /tmp/sve_sme_probe ]; then PROBE=/tmp/sve_sme_probe; else
        echo "FAIL: no SVE/SME probe binary"; RC=1; PROBE=""
    fi
fi
if [ -n "$PROBE" ]; then
    A3=$(timeout 300 "$G5" --quiet --outdir="$OUT" configs/se/arm_chaos.py \
         --cpu O3 --cmd "$PROBE" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(SVE|SME)' | tr '\n' ';')
    echo "anchor3 SVE/SME: $A3"
    echo "$A3" | grep -q "SVE VL = 16 bytes" || { echo "FAIL: SVE probe"; RC=1; }
    echo "$A3" | grep -q "SME SVL = 16 bytes" || { echo "FAIL: SME probe"; RC=1; }
fi

rm -rf "$OUT"
[ "$RC" -eq 0 ] && echo "RESULT: ALL ANCHORS OK" || echo "RESULT: FAILURES PRESENT"
exit $RC

                    "2.6GHz. NOT cycle-exact (no distributed scheduler / no "
                    "partition L3 / no bufferless NoC).")
p.add_argument("--clk_freq", default="2GHz",

               help="H2 window sweep: O3 ROB entries (0 = leave gem5 default)")
p.add_argument("--phys_int_regs", type=int, default=0,
               help="H2 window sweep: physical int regs (0 = leave gem5 default)")
p.add_argument("--phys_float_regs", type=int, default=192)
p.add_argument("--lq_entries", type=int, default=0,
               help="H2 window sweep: LQ entries (0 = leave gem5 default)")
p.add_argument("--sq_entries", type=int, default=0,
               help="H2 window sweep: SQ entries (0 = leave gem5 default)")
p.add_argument("--iq_entries", type=int, default=66)
# CHAOSReg params (architectural-state; honest about limits)
p.add_argument("--chaos_reg", action="store_true")

static void sme_fmopa_kernel(const SmeFmopaParams *p)
{
    asm volatile(
        "ldr x1, [x0, #0]\n\t"       /* a          */
        "ldr x2, [x0, #8]\n\t"       /* b          */
        "ldr x3, [x0, #16]\n\t"      /* out        */
        "smstart sm\n\t"
        "smstart za\n\t"
        "zero {za}\n\t"
        "ptrue p0.s\n\t"
        "ptrue p1.s\n\t"
        "mov x9, #0\n"               /* k = 0      */
        "1:\n\t"
        "cmp x9, #64\n\t"
        "b.ge 2f\n\t"
        "add x10, x1, x9, lsl #6\n\t"    /* &a[k*16]   */
        "add x11, x2, x9, lsl #6\n\t"    /* &b[k*16]   */
        "ld1w {z0.s}, p0/z, [x10]\n\t"
        "ld1w {z1.s}, p0/z, [x11]\n\t"
        "fmopa za0.s, p0/m, p1/m, z0.s, z1.s\n\t"
        "add x9, x9, #1\n\t"
        "b 1b\n"
        "2:\n\t"
        "mov x9, #0\n"               /* row = 0    */
        "3:\n\t"
        "cmp x9, #16\n\t"
        "b.ge 4f\n\t"
        "mov w12, w9\n\t"
        "add x13, x3, x9, lsl #6\n\t"    /* &out[r*16] */
        "st1w {za0h.s[w12, 0]}, p0, [x13]\n\t"
        "add x9, x9, #1\n\t"
        "b 3b\n"
        "4:\n\t"
        "smstop za\n\t"
        "smstop sm\n\t"
        "ret\n\t"
    );
}
#endif

input.command:
cd ~/wangxu/operator/gem5-fi/workloads/sdcshield && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
s = open('sme_fmopa_dual.c').read()
old = '''    /* Scalar golden with the identical operation order and the
     * single-rounding fma the hardware FMOPA accumulate performs. */
    static float golden[N_F32 * N_F32];
    memset(golden, 0, sizeof golden);
    for (int k = 0; k < K_FMOPA; ++k)
        for (int r = 0; r < N_F32; ++r)
            for (int c = 0; c < N_F32; ++c)
                golden[(size_t)r * N_F32 + c] = fmaf(
                    a[(size_t)k * N_F32 + r], b[(size_t)k * N_F32 + c],
                    golden[(size_t)r * N_F32 + c]);'''
new = '''    /* Scalar golden, same op order. SEMANTIC ADAPTATION (F4, empirically
     * confirmed by the first J1' run: random-mode fmaf golden mismatches
     * gem5's FMOPA on ~70% of tile cells): gem5 implements FMOPA as
     * fplibMul + fplibAdd — double rounding — so the in-sim golden uses
     * the same mul-then-add double rounding. On the fixed-mode discrete
     * 64-level grid both roundings coincide (FAILS=0 with fmaf too).
     * Real-hardware single-rounding correctness is the sdcshield test's
     * own fmaf golden (PR #237), a separate layer from this FI oracle. */
    static float golden[N_F32 * N_F32];
    memset(golden, 0, sizeof golden);
    for (int k = 0; k < K_FMOPA; ++k)
        for (int r = 0; r < N_F32; ++r)
            for (int c = 0; c < N_F32; ++c)
                golden[(size_t)r * N_F32 + c] =
                    a[(size_t)k * N_F32 + r] * b[(size_t)k * N_F32 + c] +
                    golden[(size_t)r * N_F32 + c];'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open('sme_fmopa_dual.c','w').write(s)
print("golden -> double-rounding semantics")
PYEOF

content.thinking:
还是 FAILS=181-190！双舍入 golden 没有消除分歧。说明 gem5 的 FMOPA 与"mul+add"也不一致——分歧不是（只是）双舍任问题。

深挖：gem5 FMOPA 的实现是：
```
TPDElem res = fplibMul(val1, val2, fpscr);
tile[j][i] = fplibAdd(tile[j][i], res, fpscr);
```
fplibMul/fplibAdd 是 **FPSCR 舍入模式下的软件浮点**。而 C 的 `a*b`/`acc+` 用的是**当前 FPSCR/RMODE 的硬件浮点**（默认 RN）。理论上一致……除非：
1. fplib 的实现有偏差（fplib 是 gem5 内嵌的 ARM 软浮点库——它按 AArch64 语义实现，应该正确）
2. **FPSCR 的 FZ（flush-to-zero）/ 舍入模式**：fplib 用 fpscr（kernel 里 smstart 后 FPSCR 状态）——SE 下 gem5 的初始 FPSCR 是什么？如果 FZ=1，fplib 会 flush 次正规，而 C 编译的标量运算（-O2，可能用 FMA 合并！**clang -O2 会把 `a*b + golden` 重新融合成 fmaf（fmla 指令）！**）

**啊这才是问题**：`golden = a*b + golden` 在 -O2 下被 clang 优化成 **fmadd（融合！）**——双舍入意图被编译器融合回单舍入！C 标准：`x*y + z` 允许编译器用 FMA（FP_CONTRACT）。需要 `-ffp-contract=off` 或 volatile 强制分离。

修正：编译加 `-ffp-contract=off`（标准做法）。重新编译（编译命令在 Makefile/提交信息里也要同步）。

另一个可能因素：tile 的读出值与 golden 差多少？FAILS 数量 181~190/256——如果只是末位 ulp 差，融合假设成立。先试 -ffp-contract=off。

content.text: 双舍任 golden 仍失配 —— 根因：clang -O2 把 `a*b + golden` **重新融合成 fmla**（FP_CONTRACT），双舍任意图被编译器抹掉。加 `-ffp-contract=off` 重编：

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sve_sme_fi_pilot.sh — Task 7 FI pilot (J2') for the four SVE/SME
# dual-channel kernels (plan 2026-10-13-sve-sme-fi-eval).
#
# For every (kernel x injector x mode x seed):
#   1. baseline run (no injection) — per-seed golden (random modes draw
#      different data per seed, so the baseline must be per-seed);
#   2. injected run — classify against the baseline:
#        Detected : SDCSHIELD_FAILS>0 or exit!=0 or checksum != baseline
#        Inactive : numFaultsInjected == 0 (never fired)
#        Masked   : fired (stats) but identical output
#        Hang     : gem5 timeout
# Injectors: physvec (CHAOSPhysReg, VecRegClass, 64-bit lanes) and
#            fpumant (CHAOSFPU, mantissa segment).
# NOTE: first_clock is in CYCLES (CHAOSPhysReg casts to Cycles), and the
#       kernels run ~1-3M cycles total; 300k lands inside the compute
#       section of all four.
# Usage: bash tools/sve_sme_fi_pilot.sh [N_SEEDS]
set -u
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
source ~/gem5-deps/env.sh
G5=CHAOS/gem5/build/ARM/gem5.opt
CFG=configs/se/arm_chaos.py
N=${1:-5}
FIRSTCLOCK=300000
OUTCSV=fi_research/sve_sme_pilot_results.csv
mkdir -p fi_research /tmp/sve_sme_pilot
echo "kernel,injector,mode,seed,classification,faults_injected,checksum,base_checksum" > "$OUTCSV"

run_case() { # kernel injector mode seed inject_extra...
    local kernel=$1 injector=$2 mode=$3 seed=$4; shift 4
    local od="/tmp/sve_sme_pilot/${kernel}_${injector}_${mode}_${seed}"
    local base extra out bcs cs cls finj
    base=$(timeout 600 "$G5" --quiet --outdir="$od-base" "$CFG" --cpu O3 \
           --cmd "workloads/sdcshield/$kernel" --sve_vl 4 --sme_vl 4 \
           --workload_args "$mode $seed" 2>/dev/null | \
           grep -E '^[0-9a-f]{16}$' | tail -1)
    if [ -z "$base" ]; then
        echo "$kernel,$injector,$mode,$seed,BASELINE_HANG,0,," >> "$OUTCSV"
        return
    fi
    out=$(timeout 600 "$G5" --quiet --outdir="$od-inj" "$CFG" --cpu O3 \
          --cmd "workloads/sdcshield/$kernel" --sve_vl 4 --sme_vl 4 \
          --workload_args "$mode $seed" "$@" 2>/dev/null)
    cs=$(echo "$out" | grep -E '^[0-9a-f]{16}$' | tail -1)
    finj=$(grep -oE 'numFaultsInjected\s+[0-9]+' "$od-inj/stats.txt" 2>/dev/null \
           | awk '{print $2}')
    finj=${finj:-0}
    local fails=$(echo "$out" | grep -oE 'SDCSHIELD_FAILS=[0-9]+' | cut -d= -f2)
    if [ -z "$cs" ]; then cls=Hang
    elif [ "${fails:-0}" != "0" ]; then cls=Detected
    elif [ "$cs" != "$base" ]; then cls=Detected   # channel B differs => the
                                                   # corrupted state changed
                                                   # the hw output bits
    elif [ "$finj" -eq 0 ]; then cls=Inactive
    else cls=Masked
    fi
    echo "$kernel,$injector,$mode,$seed,$cls,$finj,$cs,$base" >> "$OUTCSV"
    echo "  $kernel/$injector/$mode/$seed -> $cls (faults=$finj)"
}

KERNELS="fpu_special_sve_dual stencil_axis_dual sme_fmopa_dual sme_za_tileview_dual"
for kernel in $KERNELS; do
    for mode in fixed random; do
        for seed in $(seq 1 "$N"); do
            run_case "$kernel" physvec "$mode" "$seed" \
                --chaos_phys --phys_reg_class vector --vec_lane_width 64 \
                --rng_seed $((seed * 1000 + 7)) --first_clock $FIRSTCLOCK
            run_case "$kernel" fpumant "$mode" "$seed" \
                --chaos_fpu --fpu_bit_segment mantissa \
                --rng_seed $((seed * 1000 + 13)) --first_clock $FIRSTCLOCK
        done
    done
done

echo "=== summary ==="
awk -F, 'NR>1 {k[$1"/"$2"/"$3"/"$5]++} END {for (x in k) print x, k[x]}' "$OUTCSV" | sort
echo "CSV: $OUTCSV"

1. **触发窗混淆确认**：fixed 931,790 cycles vs random 2,145,253 cycles（random 表 16³ vs 12³ = 2.37×——周期比 2.3× 吻合）。300k cycles 在 fixed 中是 32%（sweep 段内），在 random 中只有 14%（可能还在表构建/早期 sweep）——**但 random 14% 处应该也在 sweep 里**（表构建只有 ~10k 周期，sweep 从很早开始）……嗯，2.1M cycles 的 300k=14% 处：程序结构是 main 开头（表构建，几万周期）→ sweep_f32 → sweep_f64 → printf。300k 处应该已进入 sweep_f32 深处。那为何 random 全 Masked？

   另一个解释：**FPU 注入的位翻转命中值**。CHAOSFPU mantissa 段翻转——命中"活"结果且传播到 memcmp 的概率取决于数据流。fixed 表的值（NAN/INF/0/denorm/max/min）——**mantissa 翻转在特殊值上效果显著**（如 denorm_min 的 mantissa 位翻转改变数值；0.0 的 mantissa 翻转变 denorm！）。random 值是普通数——mantissa 翻转只改 1 ulp，但 fpu_special 的比较是 byte-exact——1 ulp 也该检出！

   等等——除非注入命中在 **NaN 结果**上：NaN payload 差异被类比较掩盖（isnan 双侧 → ok）！fixed 表大量组合产生 NaN（NaN×任何=NaN）→ mantissa 翻转命中 NaN 传播路径 → 被 NaN-class 比较掩盖？不对，那 fixed 应该更难检出……

   反过来：**fixed 检出多**的机制可能是：mantissa 翻转命中**操作数/中间值**，传播到结果。而 random 模式周期长 2.3×——同样的 300k 窗口处，每条指令的"重要性"不同……

   其实 n=5 太小，不适合深挖机理。**T8 的设计必须对齐触发窗**（按各自总周期 50% 设窗），然后扩大 n。此外 physvec 全 Masked（瞬态 PRF 单 bit 翻转打中活向量值的概率本来就低——fpu 的 pilot 历史也是大量 Masked）。

2. **CHAOSFPU 覆盖 FloatRegClass + VecRegClass**（FP 标量 + SIMD 向量写回都打）✓ 所以 stencil 的 svmla 写回在覆盖内。stencil Masked 的原因：20k/80k 窗口 + 短 kernel（207k 总周期，80k=39% 处应该在中段）——但 stencil 的计算段（ITERS×RADIUS 循环）占绝大部分，注入打中活值应可检出……为何全 Masked？

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sve_sme_fi_diversity.sh — Task 8 diversity campaign (J3').
#
# Question: does the PR #237 seed-randomized input (random mode) widen the
# DETECTION SURFACE over the fixed-formula input (fixed mode) under the
# same injector family?
#
# Design (confound-controlled vs the Task 7 pilot):
#   - ALIGNED TRIGGER WINDOW: first_clock = 50% of each (kernel, mode)
#     baseline's total cycles, measured at runtime from the baseline run's
#     stats (Task 7 showed fixed 932k vs random 2146k cycles for
#     fpu_special — a shared absolute window lands in different code
#     sections, which confounds the fixed-vs-random comparison).
#   - Per-seed baselines (random data differs per seed).
#   - n seeds per cell; rng_seed varies the injection site each run.
# J3' (preregistered): exists an injector config C with fixed = Masked/
#   Escape but random (>=5-seed union) = Detected. Not met => report
#   honestly (input pattern does not change the detection surface in this
#   injection space).
# Usage: bash tools/sve_sme_fi_diversity.sh [N_SEEDS]
set -u
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
source ~/gem5-deps/env.sh
G5=CHAOS/gem5/build/ARM/gem5.opt
CFG=configs/se/arm_chaos.py
N=${1:-10}
OUTCSV=fi_research/sve_sme_diversity_results.csv
mkdir -p fi_research /tmp/sve_sme_div
echo "kernel,injector,mode,seed,classification,faults_injected,first_clock,total_cycles" > "$OUTCSV"

total_cycles() { # outdir -> cycles
    grep -oE "numCycles +[0-9]+" "$1/stats.txt" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "[0-9]+$"
}

run_case() { # kernel injector mode seed firstclock
    local kernel=$1 injector=$2 mode=$3 seed=$4 fc=$5
    local od="/tmp/sve_sme_div/${kernel}_${injector}_${mode}_${seed}"
    local base out cs cls finj fails tc
    base=$(timeout 900 "$G5" --quiet --outdir="$od-base" "$CFG" --cpu O3 \
           --cmd "workloads/sdcshield/$kernel" --sve_vl 4 --sme_vl 4 \
           --workload_args "$mode $seed" 2>/dev/null | \
           grep -E '^[0-9a-f]{16}$' | tail -1)
    tc=$(total_cycles "$od-base")
    if [ -z "$base" ] || [ -z "$tc" ]; then
        echo "$kernel,$injector,$mode,$seed,BASELINE_HANG,0,$fc," >> "$OUTCSV"
        return
    fi
    out=$(timeout 900 "$G5" --quiet --outdir="$od-inj" "$CFG" --cpu O3 \
          --cmd "workloads/sdcshield/$kernel" --sve_vl 4 --sme_vl 4 \
          --workload_args "$mode $seed" \
          --chaos_fpu --fpu_bit_segment mantissa \
          --rng_seed $((seed * 7919 + 41)) --first_clock "$fc" 2>/dev/null)
    cs=$(echo "$out" | grep -E '^[0-9a-f]{16}$' | tail -1)
    finj=$(grep -oE 'numFaultsInjected +[0-9]+' "$od-inj/stats.txt" 2>/dev/null \
           | grep -oE '[0-9]+$'); finj=${finj:-0}

周期对齐后（fixed 窗 465,895 = 50%，random 窗 1,072,626 = 50%）：
- fixed：3/10 Detected（seed 3、5、8）
- random（到 seed 8）：0/8 Detected

fixed 检出率 30% vs random 0%。**周期对齐后差异仍然存在**——这不是触发窗混淆。为什么 random 更难检出？

技术分析（重要，这决定 J3' 的裁决叙事）：
1. **CHAOSFPU mantissa 注入的命中机制**：注入在 FP/Vec 写回路径翻转 mantissa 位段。检出 = 翻转的结果进入 memcmp 比较（sw 与 hw 之一被改变，或 hw 结果位进 checksum）。
2. **fixed vs random 的数值差异**：fixed 表的 12 特殊值含 **denorm_min（次正规最小值）**——mantissa 位段在 denorm 上翻转产生**巨大的相对变化**（denorm 的 mantissa 就是全部数值）；而 random 普通数的 mantissa 翻转是 1-ulp 级。等等——byte-exact 比较下 1-ulp 也该检出！
3. **真正的机制候选**：FPU 注入命中哪条指令的写回。**svdup_f32(c)**（把 c 广播到向量）也走 Vec 写回！还有 `fmaf` 标量（FloatRegClass）。注入点由 rng_seed + first_clock 决定，在两模式里命中的指令流不同（random 的 sweep 更长，同样的 rng 序列命中不同类型的指令）。
4. 还有一个更微妙的：**fixed 表 12 值中 9 个是"非正规/极值"**，svmla 的结果多为 NaN/Inf/0——**NaN 结果的 hw 位**进 checksum（fnv_u64(hwv[lane])）。NaN payload 的 mantissa 翻转 → checksum 变化 → **通道 B Detected**（即便 NaN-class 比较放过它）！而 random 值的结果是普通数……不对，普通数 mantissa 翻转也会进 checksum。

   等等——Masked 意味着 checksum 完全没变。即注入的那次写回的值**没有进入任何 hwv 数组**（被覆盖/是死值）。所以差异本质是**注入命中的指令是否承载活数据流**。

   random 模式 2.1M cycles 里 sweep 占比高（表构建部分相同），50% 处都在 sweep_f32 内。fixed 在 seed N 的注入点位（rng_seed 相同公式 seed*7919+41）——fixed 和 random 的 rng_seed 不同（同 seed 值但代码流不同）→ 命中指令不同。

   **本质**：n=10 的采样里，fixed 的注入点 3/10 命中活数据，random 0/10。这可能是**采样噪声**（fixed 30%±，random 可能 10-20%），也可能有系统差（random 的活值指令密度低？——16³ vs 12³ 的循环体相同，活值密度应该相近）。

   还有一个**关键候选机制**：`svdup_f32(c)` 的写回！fixed 表 c 的 12 个值是常量广播——它们在循环中重复；random 的 c 含随机值。嗯不改变活值性。

   **务实裁决路径**：n=10 太小。J3' 的预注册判据是"存在注入配置 C：fixed Masked 而 random 并集 Detected"。当前数据**反向**（fixed 3/10、random 0/10）。等 stencil 格跑完看全貌。如果 random 始终 0——**J3' 不成立**，如实报告："在该注入空间（FPU mantissa 瞬态、单点、周期对齐窗）内，随机化输入未展现检出面优势；fixed 特殊值表反而更敏感（denorm/NaN 传播位放大）。" 这本身是**有价值的负结果**——它说明 PR #237 随机化的收益主张（输入多样性→检出多样性）在**这类注入**下不成立，收益可能体现在其他故障形态（永久故障、多位、不同单元）。

   等等，还有一个更深刻的解读方向：**检出率 ≠ 检出面（diversity of detections）**。J3' 的原始设计意图是"随机化让不同 seed 覆盖不同故障点"。random 模式的价值主张其实在于：**跨 seed 的注入点位与数据的不同组合**——但我们的实验里注入点位由 rng_seed 控制（与数据 seed 独立），所以 random 的"多样性"体现在**同一注入点在不同数据上是否都检出**（数据的检出鲁棒性）。

   实验设计上还有一个我没控制的混淆：**fixed 和 random 用了相同公式 rng_seed=seed*7919+41**，但注入器内部 rng 消费的节奏不同（代码流不同）→ 实际注入的寄存器/bit 不同。严格说 fixed vs random 的对比是"两个不同注入分布"的对比——不完美但可接受（模式间的指令流本来就无法对齐）。

等 campaign 完成看 stencil + 完整汇总再裁决。stencil 的 fpumant：fixed 和 random 的周期应该接近（几何相同，数据生成 O(同样大小)）——它是更干净的对比。

# Writing Plans

## Overview

Write comprehensive implementation plans assuming the engineer has zero context for our codebase and questionable taste. Document everything they need to know: which files to touch for each task, code, testing, docs they might need to check, how to test it. Give them the whole plan as bite-sized tasks. DRY. YAGNI. TDD. Frequent commits.

Assume they are a skilled developer, but know almost nothing about our toolset or problem domain. Assume they don't know good test design very well.

**Announce at start:** "I'm using the writing-plans skill to create the implementation plan."

**Context:** If working in an isolated worktree, it should have been created via the `superpowers:using-git-worktrees` skill at execution time.

**Save plans to:** `docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<feature-name>.md`
- (User preferences for plan location override this default)

## Scope Check

If the spec covers multiple independent subsystems, it should have been broken into sub-project specs during brainstorming. If it wasn't, suggest breaking this into separate plans — one per subsystem. Each plan should produce working, testable software on its own.

## File Structure

Before defining tasks, map out which files will be created or modified and what each one is responsible for. This is where decomposition decisions get locked in.

- Design units with clear boundaries and well-defined interfaces. Each file should have one clear responsibility.
- You reason best about code you can hold in context at once, and your edits are more reliable when files are focused. Prefer smaller, focused files over large ones that do too much.
- Files that change together should live together. Split by responsibility, not by technical layer.
- In existing codebases, follow established patterns. If the codebase uses large files, don't unilaterally restructure - but if a file you're modifying has grown unwieldy, including a split in the plan is reasonable.

This structure informs the task decomposition. Each task should produce self-contained changes that make sense independently.

## Task Right-Sizing

A task is the smallest unit that carries its own test cycle and is worth a
fresh reviewer's gate. When drawing task boundaries: fold setup,
configuration, scaffolding, and documentation steps into the task whose
deliverable needs them; split only where a reviewer could meaningfully
reject one task while approving its neighbor. Each task ends with an
independently testable deliverable.

## Bite-Sized Task Granularity

**Each step is one action (2-5 minutes):**
- "Write the failing test" - step
- "Run it to make sure it fails" - step
- "Implement the minimal code to make the test pass" - step
- "Run the tests and make sure they pass" - step
- "Commit" - step

## Plan Document Header

**Every plan MUST start with this header:**

```markdown
# [Feature Name] Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** [One sentence describing what this builds]

**Architecture:** [2-3 sentences about approach]

**Tech Stack:** [Key technologies/libraries]

**Spec:** [path to the spec/design doc this plan implements — the plan
argues from the spec, so the spec travels with it; executors read both]

## Global Constraints

[The spec's project-wide requirements — version floors, dependency limits,
naming and copy rules, platform requirements — one line each, with exact
values copied verbatim from the spec. Every task's requirements implicitly
include this section.]

---
```

## Task Structure

````markdown
### Task N: [Component Name]

**Files:**
- Create: `exact/path/to/file.py`
- Modify: `exact/path/to/existing.py:123-145`
- Test: `tests/exact/path/to/test.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: [what this task uses from earlier tasks — exact signatures]
- Produces: [what later tasks rely on — exact function names, parameter
  and return types. A task's implementer sees only their own task; this
  block is how they learn the names and types neighboring tasks use.]

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```python
def test_specific_behavior():
    result = function(input)
    assert result == expected
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run test to verify it fails**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: FAIL with "function not defined"

- [ ] **Step 3: Write minimal implementation**

```python
def function(input):
    return expected
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run test to verify it passes**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: PASS

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**

```bash
git add tests/path/test.py src/path/file.py
git commit -m "feat: add specific feature"
```
````

## No Placeholders

Every step must contain the actual content an engineer needs. These are **plan failures** — never write them:
- "TBD", "TODO", "implement later", "fill in details"
- "Add appropriate error handling" / "add validation" / "handle edge cases"
- "Write tests for the above" (without actual test code)
- "Similar to Task N" (repeat the code — the engineer may be reading tasks out of order)
- Steps that describe what to do without showing how (code blocks required for code steps)
- References to types, functions, or methods not defined in any task

## Self-Review

After writing the complete plan, look at the spec with fresh eyes and check the plan against it. This is a checklist you run yourself — not a subagent dispatch.

**1. Spec coverage:** Skim each section/requirement in the spec. Can you point to a task that implements it? List any gaps.

**2. Placeholder scan:** Search your plan for red flags — any of the patterns from the "No Placeholders" section above. Fix them.

**3. Type consistency:** Do the types, method signatures, and property names you used in later tasks match what you defined in earlier tasks? A function called `clearLayers()` in Task 3 but `clearFullLayers()` in Task 7 is a bug.

If you find issues, fix them inline. No need to re-review — just fix and move on. If you find a spec requirement with no task, add the task.

## Execution Handoff

After saving the plan, offer execution choice:

**"Plan complete and saved to `docs/superpowers/plans/<filename>.md`. Two execution options:**

**1. Subagent-Driven (recommended)** - I dispatch a fresh subagent per task, review between tasks, fast iteration

**2. Inline Execution** - Execute tasks in this session using executing-plans, batch execution with checkpoints

**Which approach?"**

**If Subagent-Driven chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development
- Fresh subagent per task + two-stage review

**If Inline Execution chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:executing-plans
- Batch execution with checkpoints for review

哦！！我明白了：错误行号 136 指向的是 `add x10, x1, x10, lsl #2` 但**报错的是 clang 的 inline-asm parser 对这条 add**……让我仔细看错误："expected 'sxtx' 'uxtx' or 'lsl' with optional integer in range [0, 4]"——这是 **ADD (extended register)** 的诊断（索引形式）。`add x10, x1, x10, lsl #2` 是 ADD (shifted register) 形式，移位范围 [0,63]，合法。

除非**实际汇编里 mul 那行与 add 被合并**……不。让我换个角度：也许报错的是 137 行的 `add x11, x2, x10, x2, lsl #0`（**4 操作数 add**——非法！）。但错误说 136 行……clang 的行号 136 是 C 源行——136 行是 add x10 那行，但错误可能是**它实例化后的 asm**。

等等，137 行 `add x11, x2, x10, x2, lsl #0`——**这就是非法的**（ADD 只有 3 寄存器 + 可选移位：`add x11, x2, x10`，不能 `add x11, x2, x10, x2, lsl #0`）。我当时写这行是笔误（想把 x2+偏移）。

而且逻辑也错了：x11 应该 = x2 + k*n*4 = b 的行地址——`mul x11, x9, x15; add x11, x2, x11, lsl #2`（或复用 x10 偏移：x10 目前 = x1 + off（a 的地址）——错，x10 已经加了 x1。b 需要 x2 + off。所以要么先算纯偏移再分别加：
```
mul x14, x9, x15      /* k*n            */
add x10, x1, x14, lsl #2  /* &a[k*n]    */
add x11, x2, x14, lsl #2  /* &b[k*n]    */
```
✓ 正确。clang 报错行号有偏移（报 136 是因为 137 的解析错误恢复混乱）。修这两行。

              '#define N_D_MAX 16  /* upper bound: SVL=1024bit => 16 f64 slices */')

     * -> 2..16). The element-size shift #3 (8 bytes/f64) is
     * SVL-independent and stays an immediate. */
    int64_t svl_bytes = 0;
    asm volatile("rdsvl %0, #1" : "=r"(svl_bytes));
    const int n = (int)(svl_bytes / 8);
    if (n < 2 || n > N_D_MAX) {

              'a[ij] = (double)((i * 131 + j) % 977) + 0.5 * (i + 1);')

# golden loops + injective index: N_D -> n
s = s.replace('''    for (int i = 0; i < N_D; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < N_D; ++j) {
            const size_t ij = (size_t)i * N_D + j;
            const size_t ji = (size_t)j * N_D + i;
            const size_t rot = (size_t)((i + 1) % N_D) * N_D + j;''',
'''    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            const size_t ij = (size_t)i * n + j;
            const size_t ji = (size_t)j * n + i;
            const size_t rot = (size_t)((i + 1) % n) * n + j;''')

# kernel: pass n as operand, register-compare bounds
s = s.replace('''static void za_tileview_kernel(const double *a, double *id_a, double *tr_a,
                               double *rot_a)
{
    asm volatile(

        "mov x1, %1\\n\\t"               /* id_a           */

content.content:
/* Measured geometry on cn23154: SME SVL = 512-bit -> 8 f64 per ZA slice
 * and an 8x8 f64 tile per ZAd view. Other SVLs are skipped, not guessed. */
static constexpr long kTileN = 8;

struct SmeZaTileviewData {
    /* Shared read-only inputs and byte-exact goldens, each kTileN*kTileN. */
    std::vector<double> a, b;
    std::vector<double> golden_id_a, golden_tr_a, golden_rot_a;
    std::vector<double> golden_id_b;
};

#if defined(__aarch64__) && defined(__clang__)

struct SmeZaParams {
    const double *a;
    const double *b;
    double *id_a;   /* za0h round trip of a           */
    double *tr_a;   /* za0v vertical read = transpose */
    double *rot_a;  /* za0h.d[r, 1] read              */
    double *id_b;   /* za1h round trip of b           */
    double *id_a2;  /* za0h re-read after za1h writes */
};

/* One smstart/smstop window, five store phases, all against the
 * zero {za} baseline. Row offsets are row*8 elements, lsl #3 scaled -
 * the exact addressing shape the probes measured with. */
__attribute__((naked))
static void za_tileview_kernel(const SmeZaParams *p)
{
    asm volatile(
        "ldr x1, [x0, #0]\n\t"
        "ldr x2, [x0, #8]\n\t"
        "ldr x3, [x0, #16]\n\t"
        "ldr x4, [x0, #24]\n\t"
        "ldr x5, [x0, #32]\n\t"
        "ldr x6, [x0, #40]\n\t"
        "ldr x7, [x0, #48]\n\t"
        "smstart sm\n\t"
        "smstart za\n\t"
        "zero {za}\n\t"
        "ptrue p0.d\n\t"
        "mov x8, #8\n\t"
        "mov x9, #0\n"
        "1:\n\t"
        "cmp x9, #8\n\t"
        "b.ge 2f\n\t"

    std::vector<double> a, b;
